transcript.content:
A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

input.query: SELECT attr_service_name AS svc, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT attr_service_name AS svc, count(*) n, avg(duration)/1e6 avg_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='STATUS_CODE_ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT attr_k8s_container_name cont, metric, count(*) n, cast(min(time) as varchar) t0, cast(max(time) as varchar) t1, round(avg(value),2) avg_v FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE metric IN ('k8s.container.ready','container.cpu.usage','container.memory.working_set') AND attr_k8s_container_name IN ('hotel-reserv-geo','hotel-reserv-rate','hotel-reserv-search','hotel-reserv-profile','hotel-reserv-reservation','hotel-reserv-recommendation','hotel-reserv-user','hotel-reserv-attractions') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY cont, metric

SELECT 'abnormal' per, span_name, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,3) avg_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) http5xx FROM abnormal_traces WHERE attr_span_kind='Client' AND (span_name LIKE 'search.%' OR span_name LIKE 'profile.%') GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'normal', span_name, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,3), sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM normal_traces WHERE attr_span_kind='Client' AND (span_name LIKE 'search.%' OR span_name LIKE 'profile.%') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
